peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 48.6% above its local comparables; 130 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (71.8): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 277 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 10). Initial resale-wave effect: 24 of the 50 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Nov 2024–Oct 2025), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,320,000 ($2,852 psf, 462–484 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,692 psf (range $1,313–1,940); 68.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $537,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $2,088,888 ($2,887 psf, 678–753 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,520 psf (range $1,824–2,829); 14.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $266,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,368,000 ($3,038 psf, 947–1,108 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,869 psf (range $1,352–2,966); 62.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $1,296,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Nov 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 9 earlier resales do not start the wave. 11 months available from Nov 2025; measurable with data to Oct 2026. Observed: 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Katong MRT about 170 m, Marine Parade MRT about 640 m; closer than 596 of 662 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 550 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 480 m), more than 281 of 662 similar developments (the same as 80); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 820 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area B about 360 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 200 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 500 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 640 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 660 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 960 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,190 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,260 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,450 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 366 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 474 new sales and 678 resales (1,152 purchases); new sales were 41.1% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 678 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 253 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 678 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 815 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.8%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
